verdict.rationale: The only recurring automation evidenced is built in: access reviews remind you to start reviews on your policy's timelines, and monitors and integrations refresh data up to daily to power continuous compliance checks. Nothing shows users defining their own scheduled jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-configurable job/workflow scheduling (cron-like or recurrence settings), the ability to schedule arbitrary automations or agent/MCP-driven tasks, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of scheduling controls.
